guarantees.claim: For each i, alert_tx_o[i] is driven by the prim_alert_sender instance u_prim_alert_sender with the given port map.
Each instance is parameterized with AsyncOn = AlertAsyncOn[i] and IsFatal = AlertIsFatal[i] from the generate variable i.
The alert_req_i port of all prim_alert_sender instances is connected to the same signal alerts[0].
The output ports alert_ack_o and alert_state_o of each prim_alert_sender are left unconnected.

assumptions.claim: prim_alert_sender correctly implements the alert handshake protocol, including acknowledging alert_req_i and driving alert_tx_o appropriately.
assumptions.risk: alert_tx_o may not assert or the handshake may break, resulting in undelivered alerts.

assumptions.claim: alerts[0] is the correct combined alert request signal intended to trigger all alert sender instances.
assumptions.cond: when any alert needs to be raised
assumptions.risk: If alerts[0] does not reflect all required alert triggers, some alerts may never fire.

assumptions.claim: The arrays AlertAsyncOn and AlertIsFatal have at least NumAlerts elements and contain valid configuration values.
assumptions.risk: Index out of bounds or incorrect alert classification may occur.

uncertain_points.claim: The unconnected alert_ack_o may cause the prim_alert_sender to stall waiting for an acknowledge, preventing the alert from completing.
uncertain_points.cond: when alert is asserted and a handshake is expected
uncertain_points.risk: Alert handshake can hang, leaving the system in an unresolved fault state.

uncertain_points.claim: All alert sender instances are triggered by the single signal alerts[0]; it is unclear whether this is intended to trigger all alerts simultaneously or if per‑alert distinction is required.
uncertain_points.risk: Alerts may be masked or fired together incorrectly, defeating independent alert handling.

uncertain_points.claim: alert_ack_o and alert_state_o are unconnected; no feedback on alert delivery or state is available for fault detection.
uncertain_points.risk: Alert transmission failures or stuck states may go completely undetected.
